title: A Multimodal Framework for Measuring Creator Communication on Short-Form Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.33043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Short-form video combines speech, imagery, and on-screen text, creating challenges for systematic content analysis. We present a five-stage multimodal framework for measuring creators' themes and communication strategies at scale. The framework integrates platform metadata, speech transcripts, and vision-language descriptions of sampled frames, then applies large language models to generate predefined indicators and open-ended labels. An audited keyword scheme consolidates thematic labels, while creator-weighted aggregation gives each account equal weight regardless of posting volume. We demonstrate the framework on 9,852 TikTok videos from sixteen creators, retaining 7,311 videos for analysis across seven themes and seven communication indicators. translated_title: 一种用于衡量短视频平台创作者传播行为的多模态框架
translated_abstract: 短视频融合了语音、图像和屏幕文字，为系统性内容分析带来了挑战。我们提出了一个五阶段多模态框架，用于大规模衡量创作者的主题与传播策略。该框架整合了平台元数据、语音转录文本以及对采样帧的视觉-语言描述，随后应用大语言模型生成预定义指标和开放式标签。经过审核的关键词方案对主题标签进行了整合，而创作者加权聚合方式则使每个账户无论发布量多少均被赋予相同权重。我们在来自十六位创作者的9,852个TikTok视频上演示了该框架，最终保留7,311个视频，围绕七个主题和七个传播指标进行分析。自动化生成的创作者画像揭示了各创作者在运用教育内容、幽默表达以及回应时事方面的显著差异。通过两位独立专家标注者的验证，得到了平均F（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个五阶段多模态框架，整合平台元数据、语音转录与大语言模型生成的视觉-语言描述，实现了对短视频创作者主题与传播策略的大规模量化分析，并在近万个TikTok视频上完成了验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-stage multimodal framework that integrates platform metadata, speech transcripts, and LLM-generated vision-language descriptions to measure short-form video creators' themes and communication strategies at scale, validated on nearly 10,000 TikTok videos.
